Method of Attack: Disabling endpoint security solutions by rebooting compromised systems into Windows Safe Mode to bypass security tools
Using PDQ Deploy to drop Windows batch scripts that modify or delete Registry keys of security tools
Creating a new user account 'newadmin' with auto-login in Safe Mode with Networking
Disabling 'legal notice' dialog registry keys to enable automatic login
Executing ransomware payload filelessly from a Domain Controller via a 'RunOnce' Registry key
Using AnyDesk remote access tool for manual control if automated payload execution fails
Impacted Systems: Windows devices with endpoint security solutions including Windows Defender, Kaspersky, Carbon Black, Trend Micro, Symantec, Bitdefender, Cylance
Attack Vector: Batch scripts deployed via PDQ Deploy
Modification/deletion of Registry keys to disable security tools
Rebooting into Safe Mode with Networking
Execution of ransomware payload from Domain Controller
